THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 02 / THE PROMPT ISSUE
NIGHT & LIFESTYLE
160
STUDY 123
Black Lace-Sleeve Top & Bob
Rights check
Source: 25013.jpg
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with a sleek black bob and
blunt bangs stands in a candlelit interior. She wears a
fitted black long-sleeve top with lace sleeves and a lace
neckline, a black leather choker, and a cross pendant
on a silver chain. Her black leather pants have a chain
belt with a silver buckle. Her expression is calm and
serious, looking off to the side. Warm candlelight and
blurred wooden furniture behind her. Palette of black,
warm amber, and silver. Sleek and moody, in the style
of a 1990s gothic film still.
Sleek, moody, 90s
WORKING NOTES
- The blunt bob and lace sleeves are the signature
shapes.
- Keep the candles for a warm, atmospheric backdrop.
